ALOHA's manual says of ALOHA's own lines: "The "uncertainty lines" around the longest threat zone enclose the region within which, about 95 percent of the time, the gas cloud is expected to remain." (epa-aloha-users-manual-2007 p. 45). hazbrief's lines use the same construction on hazbrief's outlines and have not been verified to that figure; implemented from the text and not checked against ALOHA's output. Departures: sigma_y is the held Briggs form, not the puff's own Pasquill-Gifford curve; U3 = 2.69 m/s is the 3.08 m/s wind at 10 m reduced by ALOHA's power law (n = 0.112); that sigma_y is read at x5 is a reading of the section, which does not write sigma_y(300 U3). No circle is drawn at low wind: the held texts give no rule for it.
